QUOTE: "**`deny`** — `ServerManager::execute` returns an error without routing. It is checked after approval" and "Only the deny list can block a call in that setup."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says ServerManager::execute checks is_denied and returns an error before routing, and that only the deny list can block a call once the approval callback is wired. That matches the item's substance, though the answer also lists other pre-execution blockers (MCP key checks, tier allowlist, duplicate detection).
